meta.title: Reels, Riffs & Ridgelines
meta.subtitle: Movies, live music and the outdoors around northern Vermont
notes: Movie showtimes cover the Majestic 10's Tuesday discount night and are refreshed every Monday.
Riffs and Reels come from the digest's shared Live Music and Movies calendars.
Ridgelines listings come from the shared Ridgelines calendar.
Drive times are estimates from the Burlington area. Times marked 'time not confirmed' were assumed from a venue's usual schedule, not published.

events.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
events.address: Majestic 10, 190 Boxwood St, Williston, VT 05495
events.notes:
Rated R · ~1h28m · Crime Thriller/Dramedy
An aging career pickpocket named Harry is pushed into a frantic, high-stakes chase across his city. John Turturro, Giancarlo Esposito, Tatiana Maslany, Steve Buscemi, Jamie Lee Curtis. RT 100% (25 critic reviews).
Tuesday is discount pricing (all movies, all showtimes).
No online ticketing — box office only.
